name: Proving Grounds 20: The Stilt Hollows. The bare stilts and decks of a village the bog swallowed long ago, by day in fog: rope-railed walkways two levels over the bog are the fast way and the high ground, the bog below is the slow one, wooden stairs are the only ways up, and the hag that nests on the highest deck keeps a cauldron burning green.
